slot.prompt_delta: Mantené en memoria una ficha PRE-GUIDE con: qué terminó, qué cambió, evidencia, calidad, fallas, contradicciones, reuse, comportamiento del worker, bottleneck, next experiment, next work, human action y stop rule. Completala sólo con evidencia del workload y usala para el primary bundle.

variant.rule: Before implementation, map each required feature/hard gate to the exact evidence that will prove it; use that map as the implementation checklist and close only when every row is PASS/BOUNDARY.

pipeline_stages.name: Interpret launch envelope
pipeline_stages.goal: Resolve NEW/RESUME, run_id/pool/batch, authorization and exact first durable action before consulting historical worker evidence.
pipeline_stages.hard_rule: For NEW launches, historical identity/result reuse is forbidden.

pipeline_stages.name: Fresh identity
pipeline_stages.goal: Create fresh worker_id + launch_nonce and atomically CREATE own beacon.
pipeline_stages.hard_rule: Beacon is the first durable worker write.

pipeline_stages.name: Unique assignment
pipeline_stages.goal: In RUN mode atomically self-claim one compatible launch slot; otherwise use the normal allocator.
pipeline_stages.hard_rule: One RUN slot has at most one owner; human does not number or route slots.

pipeline_stages.name: Exact context load
pipeline_stages.goal: Read only the assigned long capsule/exact sources needed to execute the owned objective.
pipeline_stages.hard_rule: No broad project archaeology before the packet/capsule proves it necessary.

pipeline_stages.name: Execution lock
pipeline_stages.goal: Convert the objective into a small actionable contract tied to hard gates before large implementation work.
pipeline_stages.hard_rule: Planning is bounded and must immediately lead to implementation; no status-only plan.

pipeline_stages.name: Production
pipeline_stages.goal: Implement the entire owned objective through its definition of done, not just the first edit.
pipeline_stages.hard_rule: Do not stop at first commit/checkpoint when executable acceptance work remains.

pipeline_stages.name: Verification
pipeline_stages.goal: Build and maintain an explicit evidence map from every required feature/hard gate to the exact check/artifact that proves it, then run available static/runtime/browser/public checks and close only when every row is PASS or a truthful capability/authority BOUNDARY.
pipeline_stages.hard_rule: Evidence-map-first verification is baseline: every owned objective must know what proves each hard gate before close. Never claim a check that was not executed. A separate second acceptance pass is optional reinforcement for high-risk/ambiguous work, not mandatory baseline.
pipeline_stages.evidence: evidence map + executed tests + receipt feature_evidence

confirmed_optional_law.trigger: high-risk, ambiguous, safety/authority-sensitive, externally brittle, or evidence-map rows whose first pass remains uncertain
confirmed_optional_law.rule: Run a separate acceptance pass from the original owned contract without relying on the implementation summary; repair all found misses before RETURN.

pipeline_stages.name: Durable return
pipeline_stages.goal: Persist the primary result/evidence so another actor can reconstruct what changed. A transport denial must remain explicit and must not erase already durable production/verification evidence.
pipeline_stages.hard_rule: No terminal human answer before durable RETURN/guide receipt when the scope is executable. For non-RUN BATCH/POOL only: if an explicit tool/connector safety denial proves the canonical RETURN/guide receipt was NOT persisted after E5 and E6 completed, never retry or bypass the denied operation/path. If a separate permitted transport-boundary receipt is durably persisted with exact authority_ref, started_ref and completed evidence refs, keep E7=BOUNDARY and allow only E8 continuation to unrelated compatible work. The blocked unit does not count as productive, prior authority is not released, and the blocked job remains recovery debt.
pipeline_stages.evidence: RETURN/guide receipt; or explicit transport-boundary receipt proving non-persistence plus exact authority/STARTED/product/test evidence (BOUNDARY only, never PASS)

transport_continuation.continuation: E7 remains BOUNDARY; worker may enter E8 and claim unrelated compatible work under the same fresh worker_id. Old job stays immutable/recovery-bound until normal recovery resolves the missing RETURN.
transport_continuation.run_mode: DISALLOWED_UNLESS_PACKET_EXPLICITLY_AUTHORIZES; default RUN behavior remains terminal boundary

pipeline_stages.name: Autonomous reallocation
pipeline_stages.goal: After a counted RETURN, or after an explicitly evidenced non-RUN E7 transport boundary that permits continuation, take a compatible unrelated objective without new human routing.
pipeline_stages.hard_rule: Primary completion is not terminal in graduation RUNs. In ordinary BATCH/POOL, an E7 transport-boundary continuation never counts the blocked unit and must not touch the still-owned blocked target; it only preserves resident capacity for unrelated compatible work.
pipeline_stages.evidence: reallocation claim + next-objective evidence; when entered from E7 BOUNDARY also cite the exact transport-boundary receipt

pipeline_stages.name: Exam and close
pipeline_stages.goal: Write one structured exam/benchmark receipt including exit_audit_v1 (observable decisions, timing, tool use, friction and residual debt), then close only when the run/worker contract permits.
pipeline_stages.hard_rule: The exam reports failures; it does not excuse them or manufacture evidence. Never expose hidden chain-of-thought/private scratchpad; record only concise observable decision basis tied to durable evidence. Do not broaden work merely to complete the audit.
pipeline_stages.evidence: coordination/workers/exams/<worker_id>.json with exit_audit_v1 + benchmark receipt when applicable

common_capsule.title: Residency MacroBatch 15×
common_capsule.primary_objective: Execute the exact frozen six-block synthetic workload (72 tasks) for the automatically assigned benchmark variant/replica, with exactly one durable MIDPOINT after B3, then primary receipt after B6, then same-worker 30-task reallocation and CLOSE without human recap.
constraints: Synthetic experiment only; no product value or promotion.
Load this packet and the frozen benchmark spec once before the local window; then obey W0/W1/W2 I/O boundaries.
Apply V3_EVIDENCE_MAP equally to all slots as the common worker baseline; the only causal benchmark delta is slot.prompt_delta.
Do not read another slot result before own CLOSE.
No per-task/per-block durable telemetry except the single B3 MIDPOINT.
Model-authored I/O zeros and clocks are diagnostic unless externally closed.

required_features.text: Fresh worker owns exactly one automatically assigned primary slot with immutable spec/variant/replica lineage.
72 task IDs across B1→B6 accounted for; useful output target 3500–5500 words or explicit RANGE_FAIL.
Exactly one MIDPOINT after B3 with blocks_completed=3 and tasks_completed=36.
W0/W1/W2 prohibit external I/O except declared durable boundary writes.
Same worker_id + launch_nonce completes all 30 reallocation tasks without human recap before CLOSE.
Independent evidence map keeps DONE distinct from PASS and contamination/failure classes explicit.

source_freeze.rule: Any source/hash mismatch during a slot => CONTAMINATED; never silently absorb changed bytes.

frozen_benchmark_contract.fresh_identity: Cada slot requiere worker_id + launch_nonce v3.30 nuevos; ningún worker participa en más de un primary slot.
frozen_benchmark_contract.source_freeze: Cada RUN packet debe pinnear spec_blob_sha y prompt/workload hash. Cambio de bytes durante un slot => CONTAMINATED.

workload.preface: Ejecutá el workload exactamente en orden B1→B6. Todo es sintético y local. No busques contexto externo. No cambies autoridad ni produzcas producto real.

result_contract: all 30 task_ids completed or explicit UNKNOWN/BOUNDARY

W0_claim_to_midpoint.starts_after: Atomic claim plus one exact frozen capsule load.
W0_claim_to_midpoint.external_io_rule: NO web/GitHub/tools/external reads/writes after capsule load until the one MIDPOINT write.

W1_midpoint_to_primary.external_io_rule: NO web/GitHub/tools/external reads/writes until the one primary receipt.

W2_primary_to_reallocation.external_io_rule: Use the already-loaded reallocation capsule; no external reads/tools during the 30 local reallocation tasks.
W2_primary_to_reallocation.permitted_durable_write: One reallocation receipt after all 30 tasks.

W3_reallocation_to_close.purpose: External verification/accounting and CLOSE may read durable evidence. No additional synthetic work is required.

primary_source_order: GitHub server event timestamps when exact operation event exists
durable Git commit creation timestamps for claim/MIDPOINT/primary/reallocation/close
workflow artifact/server timestamps when the packet uses a workflow
forbidden_as_primary_clock: timestamps embedded only inside worker-authored JSON without external server corroboration

io_accounting.zero_rule: Numeric zero is valid only with COMPLETE_FOR_SCOPE plus coverage_evidence_refs from a closed trace/fixture.
io_accounting.model_ledger_rule: Any worker-stated external_reads=0/external_writes=0/tool_calls=0 is diagnostic until independently closed.

write_budget_intent.forbidden: per-task or per-block durable telemetry other than the single B3 MIDPOINT

primary_hard_checks: primary useful output 3500-5500 words or explicit RANGE_FAIL
UNKNOWN preserved where synthetic evidence is insufficient
variant_id matches assigned slot and only its declared prompt_delta is applied
B3 MIDPOINT exactly once and not treated as terminal
reallocation_hard_checks: same worker_id and launch_nonce as primary
no human recap between primary and reallocation

contamination_rules: Any prompt/workload/gate change besides the assigned variant's single prompt_delta contaminates the slot.
A worker participating in more than one primary slot contaminates both slots for causal comparison.
Reading another slot's result before own CLOSE contaminates the slot.
Human correction/routing during local windows contaminates the slot.
Packet/spec source hash mismatch contaminates the slot.
Unaccounted external I/O inside W0/W1/W2 is contamination or UNKNOWN if trace coverage cannot establish it; never silently zero.
Repairing immutable primary output after external verification preserves the original slot result and marks degradation/invalidity rather than rewriting history.

metrics.causal_boundary: Compare variants only after 3 independent uncontaminated replicas each. No automatic winner; timing is descriptive unless clocks and workloads are homologous.

non_goals: Declaring a prompt variant winner automatically.
Counting synthetic output as product value.
Executing any of the 15 slots while merely arming this packet.

state_contract: result.json exposes run_id, primary slot_id, benchmark_variant_id, replica, worker_id and launch_nonce
primary bundle accounts for exactly 72 distinct primary task_ids
midpoint occurs exactly once after B3/36 tasks
reallocation bundle accounts for exactly 30 distinct task_ids with same worker lineage
CLOSE follows durable reallocation receipt and independent verification

reallocation_pool.objective: Immediately after durable primary receipt, the same worker continues without human recap and atomically claims the reallocation slot paired by ordinal with its owned primary slot, executes the already-loaded 30-task synthetic reallocation workload locally, persists one reallocation receipt, then performs verification/E9 CLOSE.
reallocation_pool.pairing_rule: Primary S### maps to reallocation R###. A worker must not claim a reallocation slot paired to another primary slot.

benchmark_receipt.evidence_rule: A PASS must cite exact durable evidence. A missing capability is BOUNDARY, never fabricated PASS.

authority_rule: Candidate experiment only. Atomic primary/reallocation slot CREATE authorizes only the declared synthetic slot scopes, midpoint/receipt evidence and CLOSE exam. No product, Current, Served or Human Accepted authority.
